blocks.text: Day 6 · After breakfast, a half-day excursion to Sugar Loaf. The first stop is Urca Hill, with its wide viewing area, restaurant and bar; from Sugar Loaf, enjoy a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains and islands, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. Then drive to the old centre of Rio, with its churches, monasteries, cathedral and colonial-style buildings.

blocks.text: Day 7 · After breakfast, a tour through the city to the station, where an eco-friendly train climbs through the Tijuca Forest, home to monkeys and exotic birds, to the top of Corcovado. At 710 metres above sea level stands the symbol of Rio, the 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer, built in 1931, with a breathtaking panorama of the Rio–Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, the legendary Maracanã Stadium and Sugar Loaf. Optional: a helicopter flight over Rio.
